summary.text: Watrana Rentals IPO is a book build issue of ₹120.10 crores. The issue is entirely a fresh issue of 49.02 lakh shares of ₹120.10 crore.

Watrana Rentals IPO opens for subscription on Nov 19, 2026 and closes on Nov 23, 2026. The allotment for the Watrana Rentals IPO is expected to be finalized on Nov 25, 2026. Watrana Rentals IPO will list on the NSE SME with a tentative listing date fixed as Nov 27, 2026.

Watrana Rentals IPO is set issue price band at ₹232 to ₹245 per share. The lot size for an application is 600 shares. The minimum amount of investment required by an individual investor (retail) is ₹2,94,000 (1,200 shares) (based on upper price). The minimum lot size for investment in HNI is 3 lots (1,800 shares), amounting to ₹4,41,000.
Oneview Corporate Advisors Pvt.ltd. is the book running lead manager and Maashitla Securities Pvt.Ltd. is the registrar of the issue. The Market Maker of the company is Basan Equity Broking Ltd.
Refer to Watrana Rentals IPO RHP for detailed Information.

about.text: Incorporated on November 19, 2019, Watrana Rentals Limited specializes in material and cargo handling equipment rentals, offering a fleet that includes forklifts (battery‑operated, diesel, gas), electric stackers, pallet trucks, speciality attachments (e.g., paper‑roll clamps, bale clamps, side shifters), and ground‑support gear. They engaged in the business of providing material handling equipment (“MHE”) on a rental basis and trading of new and used MHE and batteries used in MHE. They cater to customers operating across various industries, including automotive, tyre, beverage, glass, paper, logistics & warehouse.
The company's business can be segregated into the following:-
Rental Solutions : Provides rental services for MHE tailored to meet business needs for flexibility without long-term capital investment.
Trading in MHE: Engaged in trading MHE, this offer allows customers to buy material handling equipment suited to their budget and needs.
Trading in Batteries for MHEs: Offers various batteries compatible with MHE models for rental and trading clients.

As of June 30, 2026, the company owned a fleet of two thousand six hundred forty-six (2,646) MHE units and thirty-three (33) AWP units, with an additional five MHE units and two AWP units taken on rent from third party suppliers.

As of June 30, 2026, The company had 3,883 employees across various functions, including strategy and planning, administration and human resources, finance, operations, procurement, stores, safety and service.

Workforce is a key asset in delivering high-quality service to clients across India.
Quality Assurance of services is an integral part of the company's operations.

business.text: Watrana Rentals Limited is engaged in providing rental and trading solutions for material handling equipment (MHE) and cargo handling requirements. Its product portfolio includes battery-operated, diesel and gas-powered forklifts, electric stackers, pallet trucks, specialised attachments such as paper-roll clamps, bale clamps and side shifters, along with various ground-support equipment.

The company is an ISO 9001:2015, ISO 45001:2018 and ISO 14001:2015 certified supplier of industrial material handling equipment, catering to the requirements of customers across various industries in India.
The company's business operations are primarily divided into the following segments:

Rental Solutions: Offers material handling equipment on a rental basis, enabling customers to meet their operational requirements while avoiding significant upfront capital expenditure and long-term ownership commitments.
Trading in MHE: Engages in the sale of material handling equipment, providing customers with suitable equipment options based on their operational requirements and budgets.
Trading in Batteries for MHE: Supplies batteries compatible with different material handling equipment models, catering to both rental customers and equipment buyers.
The company has an extensive pan-India presence, with more than 304 rental sites, enabling it to provide equipment accessibility and timely service support to customers across different locations.

As of April 30, 2025, the company had an operational fleet of over 1,441 material handling equipment units. Its fleet comprises diesel and electric forklifts, reach trucks, battery-operated stackers, pallet trucks, order pickers, towing trucks and other equipment.
As of April 30, 2025, the company had a workforce of approximately 3,122 employees, comprising equipment operators, technicians, engineers, site supervisors and other support staff.
Experienced Promoters and Management: Backed by experienced promoters and a senior management team with strong technical knowledge and industry expertise.
Skilled Workforce: A large and trained workforce that plays an important role in delivering efficient and reliable services to customers across India.
Focus on Quality Assurance: Emphasises service quality and operational standards across its business activities.
Extensive Network Presence: Established pan-India network of rental locations, supporting wider customer reach and efficient service delivery.
